description:
Compare 2–3 specific mortgage packages side by side: average rate over the lock-in, benchmark index, effective rate and monthly instalment per year, interest paid per year, and flexibility terms (prepayment, free conversion, sale waiver, penalties, minimum loan).

Required: `packageIds` from `recommend_packages` and `loanAmount` (SGD). Optional: `tenureYears` (default 25); `dealKind`/`propertyType`/`propertyStatus` only label the comparison header.

Not for finding packages: it has no borrower context, so use `recommend_packages` for a personalised ranking. `verdicts`/`recommendedId` only carry over reasoning from a prior `recommend_packages` call; never author them.

dealKind.description: Whether the loan is a new PURCHASE or a REFINANCE from another lender. Only labels the report header; the comparison is unchanged.

packageIds.description: 2–3 package ids to compare, e.g. from `recommend_packages`.

propertyStatus.description: Stage or use of the property, e.g. COMPLETED (resale or ready-built), BTO or BUC (new, under construction). Only labels the report header; the comparison is unchanged.

propertyType.description: The kind of property securing the loan (HDB flat, private home or commercial). Only labels the report header; the comparison is unchanged.

recommendedId.description: The rank-1 package from the prior `recommend_packages` call; its column is highlighted as "Recommended". Only meaningful together with `verdicts`.

tenureYears.description: Repayment period, in years, used for each package’s instalment and interest.

verdicts.description: Per-package verdict texts carried over from a prior `recommend_packages` call (the LLM reasoning). Adds the verdict row to the comparison; omit for a verdict-free report. Do not author these by hand.

packageId.description: Package the verdict belongs to: one of `packageIds`, taken from `recommended[].packageId` of the prior `recommend_packages` call.

text.description: Verdict text, copied verbatim from the matching `recommended[].reasoning`.

name: compare_packages

avgRateLockIn.description: Mean effective rate across the lock-in years (decimal fraction); falls back to the package's effective average rate when there is no lock-in.

bankMaskIdentity.description: True when the lender identity is masked.

asOfDate.description: Date of the benchmark quote (ISO date, YYYY-MM-DD).

rate.description: Latest benchmark rate, as a decimal fraction (0.0356 = 3.56% p.a.).

benchmark.description: Benchmark the first floating tier is priced off, or null for fully fixed packages.

interestByYear.description: Interest paid per year (SGD) over the displayed lock-in years.

tag.description: Column emphasis: RECOMMENDED is highlighted; OPTION is the neutral peer tag.

icon.description: Traffic-light marker; null renders without an icon.

known.description: False when the raw bank-sheet code was not recognised and `label` carries the raw value; absent means recognised.

label.description: Short display label, e.g. "After lock-in" or "100%".

isFloating.description: True when the rate is benchmark-linked.
